name: Goblin
description: A small, wiry creature with green skin and beady red eyes
spawnText: A Goblin scurries out from the shadows, brandishing a rusty scimitar!
deathText: The Goblin lets out a shriek and collapses in a heap.
fleeText: The Goblin squeals and darts back into the darkness.
attackTexts: The Goblin lunges at {target} with its scimitar!
The Goblin takes a wild swing at {target}!
With a cackle, the Goblin slashes toward {target}!
missTexts: {target} sidesteps the Goblin's clumsy swing.
The Goblin's blade whistles past {target} harmlessly.
{target} ducks under the Goblin's wild attack.

name: Wolf
description: A lean grey wolf with bared fangs and hungry eyes
spawnText: A Wolf emerges from the treeline, growling low and circling!
deathText: The Wolf collapses with a final whimper.
fleeText: The Wolf lets out a pained yelp and retreats into the woods.
attackTexts: The Wolf lunges at {target}, jaws snapping!
The Wolf pounces toward {target} with bared fangs!
Snarling, the Wolf springs at {target}!
missTexts: {target} dodges as the Wolf snaps at empty air.
The Wolf's jaws clamp shut inches from {target}.
{target} shoves the Wolf aside before it can bite.

name: Skeleton
description: An animated pile of bones held together by dark magic, wielding a chipped shortsword
spawnText: Bones rattle as a Skeleton rises from the ground, hollow eyes glowing!
deathText: The Skeleton shatters into a pile of bones, the dark magic fading.
fleeText: The Skeleton's limbs begin to clatter apart as it retreats.
attackTexts: The Skeleton jabs its shortsword at {target}!
With empty eye sockets locked on {target}, the Skeleton strikes!
The Skeleton lurches forward, blade aimed at {target}!
missTexts: {target} parries the Skeleton's clumsy thrust.
The Skeleton's blade scrapes harmlessly off {target}'s guard.
{target} steps aside as the Skeleton swings wide.

name: Dire Wolf
description: A massive grey wolf the size of a horse, with glowing amber eyes

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: lunges forward and snaps its massive jaws

spawnText: A Dire Wolf crashes through the underbrush, teeth bared!
deathText: The Dire Wolf collapses with a final, echoing howl.
fleeText: The Dire Wolf slinks back into the shadows, wounded and whimpering.
attackTexts: The Dire Wolf lunges at {target} with snapping jaws!
The beast pounces toward {target}, fangs bared!
The Dire Wolf charges at {target}, a blur of grey fur and teeth!
missTexts: {target} rolls aside as the wolf snaps at empty air.
The wolf's jaws clamp shut inches from {target}.
{target} braces and deflects the massive beast's charge.

name: Ogre
description: A hulking brute standing ten feet tall, reeking of swamp and swinging a massive greatclub
spawnText: The ground shakes as an Ogre stomps into view, bellowing with rage!
deathText: The Ogre crashes to the earth with a thunderous impact, defeated.
fleeText: The Ogre stumbles away, clutching its wounds and groaning.
attackTexts: The Ogre brings its greatclub down toward {target} with terrifying force!
With a guttural roar, the Ogre swings at {target}!
The Ogre takes a massive overhead swing at {target}!
missTexts: {target} dives clear as the greatclub craters the ground.
The Ogre's swing goes wide, smashing into nothing.
{target} barely rolls out of the way of the crushing blow.

name: Owlbear
description: A fearsome hybrid beast with the body of a bear and the head of an owl, shrieking with fury
spawnText: An Owlbear bursts from the treeline with an ear-splitting screech!
deathText: The Owlbear lets out one final screech and falls silent.
fleeText: The Owlbear retreats into the forest, hooting angrily.
attackTexts: The Owlbear swipes its massive claws at {target}!
With a terrible screech, the Owlbear rakes at {target}!
The Owlbear lunges at {target}, talons extended!
missTexts: {target} ducks under the Owlbear's swiping claws.
The Owlbear's talons rake the air above {target}'s head.
{target} jumps back as the Owlbear's claws miss by inches.

name: Troll
description: A lanky, green-skinned horror with long arms ending in razor-sharp claws
spawnText: A Troll rises from the murky swamp, regenerating flesh knitting over old wounds!
deathText: The Troll finally stops regenerating and collapses, defeated for good.
fleeText: The Troll slinks back into the swamp, its wounds already closing.
attackTexts: The Troll rakes its claws at {target}!
With unnatural speed, the Troll slashes at {target}!
The Troll swings both arms at {target}, claws extended!
missTexts: {target} leaps back from the Troll's sweeping claws.
The Troll's claws slash through empty air where {target} just stood.
{target} deflects the Troll's strike just in time.
